title: ID0394036-DC/Si-D/DE[ta8hFv] - Restarts necessary to function
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Unfortunately, there are always problems with the fast charger, with one or both charging points going out of service. This sometimes happens every week. A software update from our backend is usually not enough. We have to reset the fast charger on the hardware side. In other words, switch it off and on again. We are therefore asking you to look into the issue in order to find a solution.

additional_info.subject: ID0394036-DC/Si-D/DE[ta8hFv] - Restarts necessary to function CRM:00315002197
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Mr. Georg from
Bauer Elektroanlagen raised this ticker regarding several “Faulted” messages in the backend.
I send in attachment his report and my observations. It seems that there are 3 big motives on why the Faulteds are appearing:
Coap polling in DC1
Communication issue, it has been occuring many many times. Please check if there is any problem with the ethernet cable and only then if it doesn't work you can replace it.
no PLC link in both outlets
Can be that the PP signal is not correctly detected. You need to measure a live session the PP and it should be somewhere around 3 to 5V. The CP is good we can see A→B2.
SuspendedEV in end session message
This can be an EV issue, I checked since the beginning of December and it's always this same EV that sends this Faulted and SuspendedEV status:
48.31.33.01.83.15

additional_info.subject: RE: 0394036 - ID0394036-DC/Si-D/DE[ta8hFv] - Restarts necessary to function CRM:01004000107
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas
naja aktuell sind keine HW fehler vorhanden. Ich habe die letzten 3 timestamps angeschaut und diese wurden durch zu lange stecken lassen nach SOC 100% oder auth fehler usw ausgelöst was aber nicht bedeutet das der charger defekt sei.
der Internal error wird unteranderem auch für mehrere CCS Error verwendet. Daher ist es eher schlecht sich danach zu richten.
InternalError Error in internal hard- or software component.
Natürlich kann auch der coap polling error  die Outlets zeitweise auf nicht verfügbar setzen. Da wird erst die FW 6.x "abhilfe" schaffen. Man müsste kucken ob und wie lange die Outlets wirklich unavailable sind.
im Anhang ist eine Übersicht für die letzte woche an unavailable stati. Ein bis Zwei mal am Tag ist wahrscheinlich bedingt durch den ECOG issue normal.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Semih
